modelspec.diagram.OperatorFamily.title: OperatorFamily
modelspec.diagram.OperatorFamily.description: The class of an operator; every glyph of one family shares an outline and an accent colour, a CSS custom property of the diagram's style (DESIGN.md § 13.1). Elementwise covers add, sub, mul, relu, gelu, sqrt, div, abs and the scalar constant; Contraction matmul; Reduction sum, mean and sum_rows; Normalization layer_norm and softmax; Attention attention; Embedding embedding and add_rows; Layout transpose, broadcast, reshape, concat and stop_gradient; Stochastic dropout and its RNG token; Loss mse, cross_entropy, smooth_l1 and any regularization term; Optimizer the update arithmetic of sgd, adamw and muon; DataIo Input and ParamRead.
